title: Impact of Hyflux’s Recent Challenges on Singapore's Water Supply
what_it_is: Impact of Hyflux’s Recent Challenges on Singapore's Water Supply

sections.label: Hyflux impact on water supply
sections.summary: Questions ask about Hyflux's impact on water supply, contingency plans, PUB's capacity to take over the desalination plant, private sector involvement and any review.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (a) what is the impact of the recent challenges facing Hyflux on our water supply; (b) what contingency plans are there in place, in particular, whether PUB has the operational capacity to take over the desalinisation plant; (c) what is the extent of private sector involvement in our water provision; and (d) whether any review should be done in light of what has happened to Hyflux.

sections.label: PUB default notice to TPL
sections.summary: PUB issued TPL a default notice on 5 March 2019 to require TPL to remedy defaults within the default notice period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: To safeguard our water security, PUB issued TPL with a default notice on 5 March 2019 to require TPL to remedy the defaults within the default notice period.

sections.label: Negative purchase price compensation
sections.summary: Based on current valuation the purchase price is negative, so TPL must pay PUB a compensation sum.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Based on current valuation, the purchase price is negative and TPL will, hence, have to pay PUB a compensation sum.

sections.label: PUB waives compensation, buys plant
sections.summary: PUB will waive the compensation sum and buy the desalination plant at zero dollars, and the PPP model still works well.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: PUB has, therefore, indicated that it is willing to waive the compensation sum and purchase the desalination plant at zero dollars.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: TPL has, in fact, noted in its letter to PUB on 20 March 2019 that if PUB terminates the WPA, it would alleviate the pressure on the rest of the Hyflux group.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In its announcement on 26 March 2019, Hyflux further stated that SM Investments Pte Ltd, the prospective investor of Hyflux, had concerns over working capital requirements post-investment and that PUB’s actions should alleviate such concerns.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The current situation with Hyflux does not mean that we should dismiss the PPP model altogether as our other PPP projects are working well.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The safeguards that PUB has built into the PPP contracts have worked well to ensure our water security.

sections.label: Water security national security
sections.summary: Water security is integral to Singapore's national security.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Water security is integral to Singapore’s national security.

sections.label: Negative valuation, PUB waives compensation
sections.summary: The Tuas desalination plant purchase price is negative, PUB will waive the compensation sum, and Maybank is paid before other general creditors including PUB.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: First, the current valuation of the purchase price for the Tuas desalination plant is negative.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Second, because of this, TPL has to pay PUB.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But PUB recognises its inability to do so, and PUB has indicated it will waive the compensation sum.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We can understand the concerns and anxiety of the retail investors and we are saddened by their plight.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But the Government cannot use taxpayers' monies to help investors recoup their investment losses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In this case, Maybank will still receive payments from TPL before all other general creditors, including PUB.
